notes.title: Dream Enders 0.3 Update
notes.notes:
The Dream Enders 0.3 update (dubbed the 'OBX/Capstone) update is now live!

Work on Dream Enders has resumed once again after its hiatus.  In this update, you can expect added or expanded content to the Applewood Manor lounge, Centralia library & general store, the wilderness path and dark cave areas, as well as the all new Castle Ruins area.  Small improvements and bug fixes have been made throughout the entire experience as well.  As always, please report any bugs that were found when playing.

Additionally, you can now help support the creation of Dream Enders directly.  Visit [url=http://www.patreon.com/cawithey]http://www.patreon.com/cawithey[/url] for more information.

Thanks!
- C. A. Withey

notes.title: Beach update
notes.notes:
I'm enjoying sun burn and sea fleas here on the beach.  As such, what better time than to update Dream Enders?

The cretin mob has been added to Arcadia, who conveniently explains that the player has reached the end of the playable content thus far.  Place holder areas have been added for the Drunken Goat tavern, Forest Path and Cave rooms.  There were also minor graphic tweaks and updates.

This update contains no new significant gameplay improvements or updates.  Will update again when when not inundated with college or work (or when at the beach again).

notes.title: Dream Enders 0.2.03b post-E.C.G.C. patch launched
notes.notes:
The latest patch for Dream Enders was made after its debut at the [b]East Cost Gaming Conference[/b].  Taking into consideration points made by the many attendees there, this update focuses primarily on player convenience and ease of use. It includes visual indicators for the dialogue boxes, pixel-perfect rendering while in windowed mode, ease-of-use options for navigation and interactions, and full controller/gamepad support ([i]as well as minor graphical and gameplay changes[/i]).

Many thanks to all those who time out of their week to meet with me and try Dream Enders out for themselves.  This update is dedicated to each of you.

As always, please report any bugs or problems found.  Thank you!

notes.title: Dream Enders 0.2.03 Released ahead of ECGC debut
notes.notes: Myself and Dream Enders will be on display this week at the East Coast Gaming Conference.  As such, the latest version of Dream Enders has just been pushed live with various cosmetic and world-building accessories on display. No new story content as of yet, but the town of Arcadia is able to be explored (such as it is). As always, report any problems or bugs as they arise.

notes.title: 0.2.02b hot-fix pushed for 'Prison2' room crash
notes.notes:
Finally nailed down and fixed the crash that some players have been experiencing with the second jail, or prison room, just below the graveyard area. This room, and all other rooms, should now be fully able to be explored as intended.  In addition, minor cosmetic updates and back-end fixes have been made in preparation for the coming content update (the town of Arcadia).

Sorry to everyone who experienced this bug for so long.  Thank you for your continuing patience!

notes.title: A small preview of the newest upcoming area...
notes.notes:
The image provided shows a glimpse of the next upcoming area in Dream Enders R.P.G.: the town of Arcadia.  Featuring some new artwork, as well as introducing new cosmetic refinements to the overworld map, this town will be significantly smaller than Centralia and will feature story updates for a select few characters (depending on your choices up to this point).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385663/3da6223eb5b3a1aa99f6bd0500f79f59c985fecc.png[/img]

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Dream Enders 0.2.02 release
notes.notes: This update features some minor graphical improvements, bug fixes, and one new cinematic at the end of the Goblin Tower, featuring Daemian and his P.V.E. guild mates.  As always, report any bugs or problems you may find.

notes.title: Dream Enders 0.2.01b hotfix (for the hotfix)
notes.notes: The last hotfix broke an issue involving saved games.  This latest patch addresses this issue, but it may be necessary to overwrite your save with a new one, or delete the old save file.  Apologies for any inconvenience.

notes.title: Dream Enders received a hotfix to address bugs
notes.notes: A hotfix has been pushed for [b]Dream Enders[/b] addressing the bugs that have been revealed to me since launch.  This includes dialogue errors, crashes when interacting with named N.P.C.s, and lighting issues.  Please reach out if any other problems are found.  Thanks, and enjoy!

notes.title: Dream Enders Early Alpha now Public!
notes.notes:
Dream Enders 0.2 has been made public as of February 8th for public review and consumption.  Basic story and interactions for areas up to and including the Goblin Tower are now available for play.  Expect unfinished content and bugs at this point in time during development.  Expect regular additions to the content and story as development continues.  Save and Load functionality added--saves should continue to work in future releases as well.

To see more of the universe in which Dream Enders exists, check out its prequel novel: 'Cora and the Dreamer,' available as an e-Book on the Amazon Bookstore.

All feedback appreciated!  Thanks!
